card.name: Incidence and prevalence wording before a rate
card.fires_on: The word incidence (or prevalence and the linking word after it) just before a rate or percentage is given, mostly in adverse-reaction text. It also fires on some amounts like million or % after a number.

modes.label: Incidence before a rate
modes.description: The word incidence right before 'of' and a frequency of a reaction.
modes.example: the<< incidence>> of immune-mediated pneumonitis was

modes.label: Prevalence and linking words
modes.description: The word of or in after prevalence, leading into a population frequency.
modes.example: The overall prevalence<< of>> sulfite sensitivity in the general population is

modes.label: Units after a number
modes.description: A percent sign or the word million right after a figure.
modes.example: Severe infusion reactions occurred in 32-68<<%>> and serious infusion reactions occurred in 4

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning 'mostly', so it seems to steer away from vague majority wording toward stated numbers.
card.plain: It lights up where a text is about to say how often something happened, as in 'the incidence of'.
